title: Open an independent program for remaining V4 IFX gate coverage
goal: Define bounded, fail-closed tranches to map and implement every missing IFX claim and specialized gate before final bundle review and P10.1 operator practice.
acceptanceCriteria: The program identifies C0–C6 outputs, independent source and negative-control evidence, exact child-Plan gates and stop conditions without claiming implementation or parity.
The published 1.1.2 archive and installation remain immutable and the historical 0.2.0 draft is not treated as a reviewed bundle for that release.
Formal Pre/Diff and existing isolated IFX/V4 package checks pass on the two documentation paths.
